language.label: Interface language
language.saveFailed: Could not save the language setting. It applies to this run only.

nav.label: Work navigation
nav.rootHint: Documents appear here once a work is open.

rootDescriptions.episodes: Manuscripts in episode order. Use “Write next episode” to create a new one.
rootDescriptions.summaries: The summary and next-episode note you left for each episode.
rootDescriptions.timeline: Events arranged by episode order and in-story time.
rootDescriptions.world: Cards for characters, places, factions and world rules.

workspace.openBody: Choose a work folder to see its manuscripts, summaries, timeline and world here. Your work stays as Markdown and JSON files in that folder.
workspace.browserOnly: Work folders cannot be opened in the browser preview. Use the desktop app (npm run tauri dev).
workspace.emptyBody: A new work will be created in this folder.
workspace.nonEmptyTitle: This folder already has other files
workspace.nonEmptyBody: This folder already has {count} item(s). They are left as they are; only the work files and folders (workspace.json, episodes, …) are added.
workspace.nonEmptyConfirm: Add work files to this folder without touching the existing files
workspace.conflictBody: These items use names the work needs. To avoid overwriting them, nothing is created in this folder.
workspace.conflictSuggest: Create it in this new subfolder instead
workspace.incompleteTitle: Creating a work stopped part-way in this folder
workspace.incompleteBody: Creating “{title}” stopped before it finished. It will be completed with the same work ID.
workspace.invalidTitle: The work information file cannot be read
workspace.invalidBody: workspace.json is damaged or in an unexpected format. The file was left untouched.
workspace.readOnlyNewer: This work was made by a newer galpi (format {version}). It is open read-only to protect it, and no file will be changed.
workspace.readOnlyLocked: This work is already open for writing in another galpi window or program. It is open read-only.
workspace.readOnlyPermission: There is no permission to write in this folder, so it is open read-only. Check the folder’s read-only attribute or permissions.
workspace.recoveredTmp: Cleaned up {count} temporary file(s) from an interrupted save. Your files are unchanged.
workspace.recoveredInit: Finished a work creation that had almost completed.
workspace.docsLater: Documents for this section arrive in a later development step.

main.label: Workspace
main.emptyRoot: No work is open, so there are no documents to show.

status.label: App status
status.runtimeBrowser: Browser preview (settings saved in this browser only)

errors.notFound: The folder cannot be found. It may have been moved or deleted.
errors.notADirectory: That is a file, not a folder.
errors.nameConflicts: Nothing was created because some names are already taken.
errors.needsConfirmation: Please confirm adding work files next to the existing files.
errors.alreadyWorkspace: This is already a work folder.
errors.notAWorkspace: This is not a work folder.
errors.invalidManifest: The work information file (workspace.json) cannot be read.
errors.newerSchema: This work was made by a newer galpi.
errors.pathOutsideWorkspace: That path points outside the work folder.
errors.staleSession: Another work has been opened in the meantime.
errors.writeConflict: The file changed elsewhere, so it was not saved.
errors.io: An error occurred while handling files.
errors.unsupported: Not available in the browser preview.
errors.editorNotFound: The editor cannot be found. Open it in another editor or set its location in Editor settings. The episode is kept.
errors.editorLaunchFailed: The editor could not be started. The episode is kept.
errors.editorNotReady: The built-in editor arrives in the next development step (session 04). Use another editor.

episodes.label: Episode {n}
episodes.opensWith: Opens in {editor} after it is created.
episodes.readOnlyNoCreate: This work is open read-only, so new episodes cannot be created. Existing manuscripts can still be opened in an editor.
episodes.createFailed: The new episode could not be created.
episodes.retrySame: Clicking again retries the same request, so it will not create two episodes.
episodes.none: No episodes yet. Use “Write next episode” to create episode 1.
episodes.titleLabel: Episode title (changing it keeps the episode ID and folder)
episodes.problems: Some episode folders cannot be read. galpi leaves them untouched.

editor.vscodePath: VS Code location (leave empty to detect)
editor.sent: Sent an open request to {editor}. Closing the editor does not change the episode or its history.
